Data Engineering & Data Products & Enablement

Platform & Software Engineering

  • Architect and scale streaming and batch processing systems (Flink, Spark, Kafka) that power real-time and analytical workloads.
  • Take responsibility for all aspects of software engineering: design, implementation, QA, and maintenance, with a CI/CD mindset (most engineers release to production every few days).
  • Design, operate, and continuously improve cloud infrastructure on AWS, applying strong judgment on performance, scalability, and cost.

  • Set and uphold code and data quality through leadership in design and code review, and act as a technical mentor to engineers on the team and in the domains you enable.
  • Translate ambiguous, cross-organizational data problems into clear, standardized solutions, and communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.

  • Experience building reusable frameworks, platforms, or tooling that other engineers depend on (not just point solutions).
  • Hands-on proficiency in both Python and Java for production systems.
  • Systems performance and tuning expertise, with a clear understanding of how architectural decisions affect scalability and cost.
  • Familiarity building REST services and working with event queue systems.
  • Familiarity with Linux and cloud infrastructure design on AWS or equivalent cloud providers.
  • Comfortable operating with autonomy in loosely defined problem spaces, breaking down complex problems into simple pragmatic solutions, and prioritizing effectively..
  • Strong interpersonal skills, intense curiosity, and enthusiasm for solving difficult problems.
  • Self-paced, organized, and detail-oriented person with a strong sense of ownership
  • Strong communication skills to effectively communicate with both business and technical teams. 

 

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages, including base salary, annual bonus, and more.
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. We take a remote-friendly approach to collaboration, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like in select locations. 
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
